Three independent reporters converged on this same underlying defect at increasing depth: security-guardian (Gate 2, INFO - noted as a pre-existing pattern merely extended), architect (Gate 3, NICE/LOW - recommended a static_assert pinning array size), and consistency-auditor (Gate 4, SHOULD/MEDIUM - the sharpest derivation, tracing the corrupted family to a CRITICAL-severity alert). Per the derivation rule the strongest read governs: SHOULD.

Fixed in 5bcd8df63: named indices (kSparkMetricIdxWatchRejected etc.) + pointer-identity static_asserts pinning each index to its token, plus a new regression test setting all four metrics to distinct values and asserting none cross-attribute.

Gate 8 re-verification: CLOSED. consistency-auditor empirically mutated a scratch copy of kSparkMetricTokens[] (swapped WatchRejected/Quarantined) and confirmed -fsyntax-only fails with a static_assert failure on exactly the two affected lines; grep-confirmed no literal [0-3] survives in the read loop; ran [spark][rollup][real]: 31/31 green. architect independently confirmed via a clean -fsyntax-only compile, calling the fix "strictly stronger" than its own Gate 3 recommendation.
